$comment: GENERATED from medically-modern/OOP-Cost-Estimator exports/payer_policy.json (scripts/export_payer_policy.py) — do not edit; replace from a fresh export.
Flag code -> text + confidence, and the confidence vocabulary. This form shows none of it to the patient (2026-10-07); kept for the server-side reader and logs.

TIER_UNVERIFIED.text: Plan has in-network tiers; which tier we are in is not verified — call the payer and add it to the tier rulebook

COINSURANCE_AMBIGUOUS.text: 271 lists more than one in-network DME coinsurance and no rule picks one — range shown

POS_UNVERIFIED.text: Payer splits DME cost share by place of service; the applicable row is not proven by claims yet — range shown

COINSURANCE_PLAN_LEVEL.text: No DME-specific coinsurance row; plan-level (medical) coinsurance used

DEDUCTIBLE_INFERRED_ZERO.text: No in-network deductible row at any level; $0 inferred because the plan reported coinsurance / OOP rows

DEDUCTIBLE_FAMILY_FALLBACK.text: No individual deductible row; family deductible used

DEDUCTIBLE_MISSING.text: No deductible row and nothing to infer from — unknown

DEDUCTIBLE_REMAINING_DERIVED.text: Deductible remaining derived from total minus year-to-date

OOP_FAMILY_FALLBACK.text: No individual OOP max row; family OOP max used

COPAY_PLAN.text: Plan charges a per-item copay in addition to / instead of coinsurance

SUPPLEMENT_PLAN_LETTER_UNCONFIRMED.text: Medicare Supplement on file — assumed to cover the balance; confirm the plan letter (K/L/HD pay less)

COMMERCIAL_SECONDARY_PRESENT.text: A commercial secondary was provided; coordination not modelled — primary share shown

DISCLAIMER_ROW_IGNORED.text: A 271 cost-share row carried disclaimer text and was ignored

CARVEOUT_ROW_IGNORED.text: 271 rows for other devices (hearing aids, breast pumps, speech devices ...) were ignored

NO_BENEFIT_ROWS.text: 271 carries no benefit rows — nothing to resolve

QMB.text: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary — patient cannot be billed

DUAL_MEDICAID_RESPONSE.text: 271 is the Medicaid-side answer for a dual; the MA plan's cost share is not visible here

PAYER_RULE_APPLIED.text: A claim-proven payer rule overrode what the 271 said

ZERO_OOP_PAYER.text: Payer / label is a 0% coinsurance payer by rule — priced after the plan deductible unless the deductible is proven waived

PRIMARY_MEDICAID.text: Primary insurance is a Medicaid product — no patient cost share

OUT_OF_NETWORK_ONLY.text: Only out-of-network cost-share rows were returned

BLUECARD_NO_DME_ROWS.text: Out-of-area Blue plan returned no DME cost-share rows; host plan must be called

UHC_COSTSHARE_UNVERIFIED.text: UnitedHealthcare/Oxford commercial — claims have contradicted the 271's DME cost share for this plan type; range shown, confirm by phone

HUMANA_GROUP_PLAN_UNVERIFIED.text: Humana employer-group plan — CGM carve-out not proven for this group; range shown, confirm by phone

LABEL_MISMATCH.text: The 271 identifies a different product than the Primary Insurance label on the board

MA_PLAN_RESPONSE_NEEDED.text: CMS 271 shows Medicare Advantage enrollment — Part B rows do not apply; cost share comes from the MA carrier's own 271

COVERAGE_INACTIVE.text: 271 reports inactive coverage — nothing here can price an order

SECONDARY_MEDICAID_COVERS.text: Secondary NY Medicaid covers the primary's cost share — patient pays $0

COPAY_ONCE_PER_DOS.text: The plan charges its copay once per date of service, not per line

COPAY_PROVIDER_TYPE_CONDITIONAL.text: The copay row is scoped to specific provider types; it may not apply to a DME supplier — shown as a range

COPAY_AMBIGUOUS.text: 271 lists several DME copays (item tiers) and nothing says which applies — shown as a range

EP_PUMP_UNVERIFIED.text: Essential Plan pump cost share has paid both $0 and the 5% row — range shown

ZERO_OOP_RULE_UNPROVEN.text: The $0 business rule for this payer is not fully proven by claims (contradictions logged) — confirm before promising $0

PAYER_RULE_UNPROVEN.text: A payer rule with Medium/Low claims evidence set this cost share — confirm by phone before quoting

OOP_REMAINING_DERIVED.text: OOP max remaining derived from total minus year-to-date

DUAL_PLAN_CONFIRM_SECONDARY.text: Plan text says Dual / D-SNP — the member likely has Medicaid secondary that covers the cost share; confirm Secondary Insurance before quoting

DUAL_COSTSHARE_UNVERIFIED.text: Dual / D-SNP plan: claims show this payer taking both $0 and the row's coinsurance from dual members — range shown until the pattern is settled; Medicaid secondary makes it $0

DEDUCTIBLE_REMAINING_UNKNOWN.text: Deductible total is known but the remaining is not reported — first order cannot be priced; recurring assumes it is met

MEDICARE_SUPPLEMENT_UNKNOWN.text: Original Medicare — $0 if the patient has a Medigap supplement (plus any Part B deductible left on plans G/N), the 20% figure if not; ask on the call and add the supplement as Secondary Insurance

DEDUCTIBLE_APPLIES_ON_ZERO_BENEFIT.text: 0% coinsurance on diabetic DME is claims-proven for this plan, but the plan deductible still applies — the first order is up to the deductible remaining

DEDUCTIBLE_ON_ZERO_UNKNOWN.text: The plan has deductible remaining and nothing proves whether it applies before the 0% / copay benefit — quoted as $0 up to the deductible; confirm on the benefits call

DEDUCTIBLE_WAIVED_BY_271.text: The 271 says our lines are not subject to the deductible (a $0 DME deductible row or 'deductible does not apply') — priced without it

DEDUCTIBLE_DME_SPECIFIC.text: The 271 carries a DME-specific deductible — that accumulator is applied to our lines, not the plan-level one

WRONG_PAYER.text: This 271 shows the check ran under the wrong payer — re-run under the right one; no estimate until then

DO_NOT_SHARE_WITH_PATIENT.text: Internal figure only — do not share the out-of-pocket estimate with the patient (Horizon BCBS)

HUMANA_MONITOR_RATE_DISPUTED.text: Humana allowed $33.44 on the E2103 monitor in error (under dispute) — the monitor is quoted at 65-100% of the Medicare allowed until a corrected ERA arrives

JLJ_PROGRAM_UNKNOWN.text: Anthem Low-Cost (JLJ): the 271 names neither Child Health Plus nor an Essential Plan tier — 0-5% shown (EP1 pays 5% on cartridges only)

PLAN_COSTSHARE_CONTRADICTED.text: Claims for this plan paid a different coinsurance than its 271 row — range shown; confirm on the benefits call
